name: Era Online: Şeref Savaşı
storyline:
In the fantastical world of Era, an ancient darkness threatens to consume the realm once more. Players step into the shoes of a hero destined to restore balance, choosing from multiple classes with deep awakening and job transfer systems to forge their unique path.

Explore a vast open world filled with ancient ruins, treacherous dungeons, and fearsome world bosses. Collect and train over 100 powerful battle spirits , building strategic teams to gain the upper hand in combat. Join or create a guild to fight alongside hundreds of players in massive guild vs guild (GVG) battles, competing for territory and glory.

Experience a true MMORPG social ecosystem with a player-driven free trade economy, diverse mounts, and rich multiplayer dungeons. The realm of Era awaits — gather your allies, return to the clan, and fight for glory!
summary: Era Online: Şeref Savaşı is a 3D fantasy MMORPG developed for the Turkish market, featuring full Turkish language support and localized voice acting. Players can explore a vast open world, engage in large-scale guild vs guild (GVG) battles with hundreds of players on screen, choose from multiple classes with awakening and job transfer systems, collect and train over 100 battle spirits (Savaş Ruhu) with strategic team building, trade freely in a player-driven economy, and enjoy a deep social MMORPG experience with guilds, dungeons, and world bosses.
